Disha Educare – Admission Guidance & Career Counselling Center

At Disha Educare, we are committed to guiding students towards the right academic and career paths. Under the guidance of Dr. Dhananjay Khanke, we provide professional admission guidance and career counselling to help students make confident decisions about their future.

We specialize in counselling and admission support for Medical, Engineering, and Pharmacy fields. Our expertise includes guidance for competitive exams such as NEET, MHT-CET, and IIT-JEE, along with admissions for courses like MBBS, BAMS, BHMS, Engineering, and Pharmacy.

At our center, we believe that every student has unique potential. To help students understand their strengths and interests better, we also conduct Psychometric Tests, which scientifically assess a student’s abilities, personality, and career suitability. This helps students and parents choose the most suitable career path.

Our goal is to provide honest guidance, clear direction, and complete admission support, ensuring that students can secure admissions in the right colleges and build successful careers.
